cues.text: The holy grail of personal finance?
Income minus expenses. What is left each month?
Save the surplus. A buffer can help avoid fees and borrowing.
Lower costs can leave an even bigger surplus.
Now rewind. Same starting point. A different monthly gap.
Spend $500 more than you earn. Borrow the difference.
Interest adds another expense. Next month, the gap grows.
I work on both sides: earn more, spend less.
A surplus can turn the direction before net worth turns positive.
Change the equation. Change the direction.
